notes: Parcels are a legal land-ownership fabric, not ground truth; 17735 polygons with only a class field.
Yard waste collection zones (14) are an operational schedule, not something OSM maps.
23161 footprints with a use class (residential, agricultural, worship, library, fire station); a fill for rural areas and building=* tags, CC0.
Official names for 86 cemeteries and burial grounds, many small rural ones; the names are the gain over unnamed landuse=cemetery areas.
19364 CC0 address points; the 2026-08-12 survey found 84% of 19,333 missing from OSM, and an import is onboarding.
Single county boundary polygon; OSM usually carries the municipal boundary already, so it is a check only.
1158 heritage buildings with historic names, designation by-law, year built and plaque text; heritage tags and names OSM mostly lacks.
Official Plan land use designations are planning policy, not ground truth.
753 road segments with heavy-vehicle bans, 3-tonne limits and reduced-load periods; hgv and maxweight tags OSM usually lacks.
Official names and park type for 60 parks, including river access points and lookouts; the names are the gain.
2168 road segments with posted speed limits, lanes and surface; maxspeed and surface across rural roads are a bulk gain.
Official Plan settlement area boundaries for 22 named settlements; a planning line, though it can help check place names.
1127 sidewalk segments with material and width; OSM traces sidewalks from imagery, so a gaps list is the most this gives.
2162 centrelines with names only, the same network as Road Speed Limits; useful to check street names, nothing more.
Subdivision plans with phase and assumption status are development records, not ground truth.
Named trails and signed routes (Trans Canada, Grand Valley, SC Johnson, rail trails) with cycling, hiking and snow use; names and routes are the gain.
11933 inventoried trees with species, DBH and height; species and individual trees OSM rarely has in bulk.
Five ward polygons, mappable as boundary=political; the council contact fields are not for OSM.
Waste collection day zones (10) are an operational schedule, not something OSM maps.
Zoning is a legal designation, not ground truth.
